molecules.name: Butyrate (butyric acid)
molecules.label_th: บิวทิเรต
molecules.role: Primary fuel for colonocytes (~70% of their energy); histone deacetylase (HDAC) inhibitor; induces Treg regulatory T-cells → anti-inflammatory

molecules.name: Acetate
molecules.label_th: อะซีเตต
molecules.role: Most abundant SCFA; absorbed into portal circulation, substrate for peripheral tissue + cholesterol synthesis; appetite/GLP-1 signaling via FFAR2/3

molecules.name: Propionate
molecules.label_th: โพรพิโอเนต
molecules.role: Suppresses hepatic gluconeogenesis; increases satiety via GLP-1/PYY; FFAR2 agonist

molecules.name: Zonulin (pre-haptoglobin 2)
molecules.label_th: โซนูลิน
molecules.role: Reversibly opens intestinal epithelial tight junctions — discovered by Fasano (2000); elevated in celiac, T1D, autoimmune disease

molecules.name: Lipopolysaccharide (LPS)
molecules.label_th: LPS (endotoxin)
molecules.role: Component of Gram-negative outer membrane; if translocated across gut barrier → TLR4 activation → systemic 'metabolic endotoxemia' and chronic low-grade inflammation

molecules.name: Secondary bile acids (deoxycholic acid, lithocholic acid)
molecules.label_th: กรดน้ำดีทุติยภูมิ
molecules.role: Produced by gut bacteria (7α-dehydroxylation) from primary bile acids; ligands of FXR and TGR5; excess DCA linked to colon cancer risk

molecules.name: Primary bile acids (cholic acid, chenodeoxycholic acid)
molecules.label_th: กรดน้ำดีปฐมภูมิ
molecules.role: Synthesised in liver from cholesterol (CYP7A1); conjugated with glycine/taurine; emulsify dietary fat for absorption

molecules.name: FXR (Farnesoid X Receptor, NR1H4)
molecules.label_th: FXR
molecules.role: Bile-acid-activated transcription factor; regulates bile acid synthesis (CYP7A1 feedback), lipid/glucose metabolism, gut barrier integrity

molecules.name: TGR5 (GPBAR1)
molecules.label_th: TGR5
molecules.role: Bile-acid-activated GPCR; triggers GLP-1 release from L-cells and thermogenesis in brown fat

molecules.name: GLP-1 (gut-derived)
molecules.label_th: GLP-1
molecules.role: Released from intestinal L-cells in response to SCFAs/nutrients; slows gastric emptying, increases satiety, augments insulin

molecules.name: Mucin (MUC2)
molecules.label_th: มิวซิน
molecules.role: Principal protein of the inner colonic mucus layer — physical barrier separating microbiota from epithelium; substrate for Akkermansia muciniphila

molecules.name: Occludin / ZO-1 (tight junction proteins)
molecules.label_th: ทาร์จังก์ชัน
molecules.role: Structural proteins of epithelial tight junctions — sealed paracellular space; regulated by zonulin pathway

molecules.name: H. pylori urease
molecules.label_th: ยูรีเอส H. pylori
molecules.role: Hydrolyses urea → ammonia + CO2 to neutralise gastric acid and enable colonisation; basis of urea breath test diagnostic

molecules.name: Serotonin (5-HT, enteric)
molecules.label_th: ซีโรโทนิน (ลำไส้)
molecules.role: ~90-95% of body's serotonin is made by enterochromaffin cells of the gut; regulates motility, secretion; indirectly modulated by microbiota metabolites

molecules.name: Akkermansia muciniphila
molecules.label_th: อัคเคอร์แมนเซีย
molecules.role: Mucin-degrading bacterium; inversely correlates with obesity/T2D; pasteurised form approved as novel food by EFSA (2021)

molecules.name: Bifidobacterium spp.
molecules.label_th: บิฟิโดแบคทีเรียม
molecules.role: Dominant infant-gut genus; ferments HMOs and fibers; widely used probiotic genus (B. longum, B. lactis)

molecules.name: Lactobacillus / Lactiplantibacillus spp.
molecules.label_th: แลคโตบาซิลลัส
molecules.role: Lactic-acid-producing; core of fermented foods; common probiotic genus (L. rhamnosus GG, L. plantarum)

molecules.name: Faecalibacterium prausnitzii
molecules.label_th: Faecalibacterium
molecules.role: Major butyrate producer; reduced in IBD; anti-inflammatory signature taxon

molecules.name: Inulin / FOS (fructo-oligosaccharide)
molecules.label_th: อินูลิน
molecules.role: Non-digestible fiber fermented by Bifidobacteria → SCFAs; FODMAP — can worsen bloating/SIBO in sensitive individuals

molecules.name: Psyllium husk (Plantago ovata)
molecules.label_th: ซัยเลียม (ใบเทียน)
molecules.role: Gel-forming soluble fiber; binds water and bile acids; improves stool form in both constipation and diarrhea; lowers LDL

molecules.name: L-Glutamine
molecules.label_th: แอล-กลูตามีน
molecules.role: Primary fuel for enterocytes; supports tight-junction integrity under stress; preserves gut barrier in critical illness (ESPEN guidance)

molecules.name: Betaine HCl
molecules.label_th: เบทาอีน HCl
molecules.role: OTC gastric-acid supplement used for hypochlorhydria; not FDA-approved for any disease; contraindicated on PPI/H2-blocker

molecules.name: Zinc-L-carnosine (polaprezinc)
molecules.label_th: ซิงค์คาร์โนซีน
molecules.role: Approved in Japan for gastric ulcer; supports mucosal repair and H. pylori suppression; shown to reduce NSAID-induced gut permeability

molecules.name: Curcumin (from turmeric)
molecules.label_th: เคอร์คูมิน
molecules.role: NF-κB inhibitor; low oral bioavailability — much reaches colon intact and interacts with microbiota; reduces mucosal inflammation markers in UC trials

organizations.name: MGH Mucosal Immunology & Biology Research Center (Fasano)

case_studies.name: Barry Marshall self-inoculation (1984)
case_studies.claim_to_fame: Drank a flask of H. pylori culture to prove Koch's postulates — developed gastritis, treated with antibiotics. Overturned the 'stress causes ulcers' dogma; led to 2005 Nobel Prize
case_studies.source: Marshall BJ, Armstrong JA, McGechie DB, Glancy RJ, Med J Aust 1985; Nobel 2005

case_studies.name: ZOE PREDICT 2 — Asnicar et al. 2021
case_studies.claim_to_fame: N=1,098 deeply phenotyped subjects — identified a panel of ~15 'favourable' and 15 'unfavourable' gut species predicting postprandial glucose/lipid responses
case_studies.source: Asnicar F et al., Nature Medicine 27, 321-332 (2021)

case_studies.name: Sonnenburg 4-generation fiber study
case_studies.claim_to_fame: Humanized mice fed low-fiber (MAC-deficient) diet lost ~75% of microbial diversity over 4 generations; diversity could not be fully restored by reintroducing fiber alone

case_studies.name: Fasano zonulin discovery
case_studies.claim_to_fame: Identified zonulin as an endogenous modulator of intestinal tight junctions — gave molecular basis for 'leaky gut' concept
case_studies.source: Wang W, Uzzau S, Goldblum SE, Fasano A, J Cell Sci 113:4435-4440 (2000)

case_studies.name: Bristol Stool Form Scale
case_studies.claim_to_fame: 7-type visual scale for stool consistency — now standard in clinical gastroenterology worldwide (IBS Rome criteria reference)
case_studies.source: Lewis SJ & Heaton KW, Scand J Gastroenterol 32(9):920-924 (1997)

case_studies.name: Akkermansia/CANTERBURY/Cani pilot
case_studies.claim_to_fame: Pasteurised Akkermansia muciniphila (3 months) improved insulin sensitivity, plasma LPS, and body weight in overweight/obese — first human A. muciniphila trial
case_studies.source: Depommier C, Everard A, Druart C et al., Nature Medicine 25, 1096-1103 (2019)

case_studies.name: Fermented food + microbiota diversity trial
case_studies.claim_to_fame: 10-week high fermented-food diet (yogurt, kefir, kimchi, kombucha) increased microbial diversity and reduced 19 inflammatory proteins; high-fiber arm did not
case_studies.source: Wastyk HC et al., Cell 184:4137-4153 (2021) — Stanford Sonnenburg/Gardner

case_studies.name: American Gut '30 plants' signature
case_studies.claim_to_fame: N>10,000 participants — those eating >30 different plant species/week had significantly more diverse gut microbiomes than those eating <10
